SupplementalInformationDetail.FormAndLineReferenceDesc: Form 990, Part VI, Section A, Line 3
SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: IN 2024, PARTNERSHIP ON AI ENGAGED AN EXTERNAL CONSULTING FIRM TO OVERSEE FINANCIAL AND OPERATIONAL MANAGEMENT. THE FIRM PROVIDED GUIDANCE AND SUPPORT FOR BUDGETING, FINANCIAL OVERSIGHT, AND DAY-TO-DAY OPERATIONS, HELPING TO ENSURE THE ORGANIZATION RAN EFFICIENTLY AND EFFECTIVELY THROUGHOUT THE YEAR.

SupplementalInformationDetail.FormAndLineReferenceDesc: Form 990, Part VI, Section B, Line 11b
SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: THE 990 IS REVIEWED BY THE CFO, CEO, AND THE AUDIT COMMITTEE.

SupplementalInformationDetail.FormAndLineReferenceDesc: Form 990, Part VI, Section B, Line 12c
SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: THE ORGANIZATION'S CONFLICT OF INTEREST POLICY IS APPLICABLE TO ANY DIRECTORS, OFFICERS, MEMBERS OF A COMMITTEE WITH BOARD-DELEGATED POWERS, OR KEY EMPLOYEES IN CONNECTION WITH ANY ACTUAL OR POSSIBLE CONFLICT OF INTEREST. AN INTERESTED PERSON MUST DISCLOSE THE EXISTENCE OF HIS OR HER FINANCIAL INTEREST AND ALL MATERIAL FACTS TO THE BOARD OF DIRECTORS OF THE CORPORATION OR TO ANY SPECIAL COMMITTEES WITH BOARD-DELEGATED POWERS CONSIDERING THE PROPOSED TRANSACTION OR ARRANGEMENT.

SupplementalInformationDetail.FormAndLineReferenceDesc: Form 990, Part VI, Section B, Line 15
SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: THE SALARY OF THE TOP MANAGEMENT POSITION IS DEVELOPED AND APPROVED BY THE BOARD OF DIRECTORS BASED ON CONTEMPORANEOUS SALARIES AND MARKET DATA. THIS PROCESS IS DOCUMENTED IN THE BOARD MINUTES. SALARY IS REVIEWED ON AN ANNUAL BASIS. THIS PROCESS WAS LAST UNDERGONE IN 2023. ALSO, IN 2023, AN INDEPENDENT FIRM/CONSULTANT WAS RETAINED TO ASSESS TOP OFFICIAL COMPENSATION. THE COO'S COMPENSATION IS DETERMINED BY THE EXECUTIVE DIRECTOR AND APPROVED BY THE BOARD. COMPENSATION IS BASED ON CONTEMPORANEOUS SALARY DATA AND COMPARATIVE COMPENSATION WITHIN THE ORGANIZATION BASED ON POSITION AND RESPONSIBILITY. SALARY IS REVIEWED ON AN ANNUAL BASIS. THIS PROCESS WAS LAST UNDERGONE IN 2023.
